modules.title: Select and filter
modules.skill: `SELECT`, `WHERE`, `ORDER BY`, `NULL`
questions: Which animals have no photo?
Which mammals does critwire list, by common name?
Why doesn't `= NULL` find a missing value?

modules.title: Group and aggregate
modules.skill: `GROUP BY`, `HAVING`, `CASE`, `COUNT(DISTINCT …)`
questions: How many records does the sample hold per year, and by basis of record?
Which species have more than 500 records?
How many datasets contributed?

modules.title: Joins
modules.skill: Inner, left and anti joins; many-to-many; reading an ERD; light spatial in plain SQL (bounding boxes, 10° bins)
questions: Which animals were recorded in Brazil?
Which have no records at all?
How many records fall in each 10° box?

modules.title: Window functions
modules.skill: CTEs, subqueries, window functions
questions: Which dataset contributed most of each species' records, and what share is that?
How does each year rank against the others?

modules.title: Keys and constraints
modules.skill: Entities; natural and surrogate keys; `PRIMARY KEY`, `FOREIGN KEY`, `UNIQUE`, `CHECK`; generated columns
questions: What does a foreign key check, and what doesn't it?
Natural or surrogate key for a species?
What does a `CHECK` refuse?

modules.title: Normalization
modules.skill: 1NF to 3NF from nested JSON; functional dependencies; when to denormalize
questions: Is a license a fact about a record or about a dataset?
What goes wrong when a dataset's title is stored on every record?

modules.title: Indexes and query plans
modules.skill: B-tree, GiST and BRIN indexes; `EXPLAIN` and `EXPLAIN ANALYZE`; planner statistics
questions: Why is this a sequential scan?
When does an index help a filter, a join or a spatial test?
What does the planner believe about a table?

modules.title: Transactions
modules.skill: ACID, MVCC, isolation levels, locks, savepoints, `ON CONFLICT`
questions: How do I re-run a failed load safely?
What does another session see while a load runs?

modules.title: Roles and privileges
modules.skill: Schemas, roles, `GRANT` and `REVOKE`, default privileges, least privilege, a taste of row-level security
questions: How do I give a reporting tool read-only access to one schema and nothing else?
What do default privileges change?

modules.title: Star schemas
modules.skill: Grain, facts, dimensions, conformed dimensions, unknown members, slowly changing dimensions (types 1 and 2); star vs snowflake; export
questions: What is one record fact's grain?
Which dimensions does it share with habitat area per country?
Where does a record with no country go?

modules.title: Coordinate reference systems
modules.skill: SRIDs, `ST_Transform`, geometry vs geography, Web Mercator's area error
questions: How big is Tasmania in EPSG:3857, in EPSG:3577 and as geography?
Why does Web Mercator overstate it?

modules.title: Loading and validating shapes
modules.skill: The loader, WKT and WKB, `ST_IsValid`, `ST_MakeValid`
questions: Which shapes are invalid, and why?
What does `ST_MakeValid` change?

modules.title: Spatial joins
modules.skill: `ST_Contains`, `ST_Covers`, `ST_Intersects`; point in polygon; records on boundaries
questions: Do GBIF's country codes agree with the country outlines?
Which records fall on a coast or in no country?

modules.title: Distance and overlay
modules.skill: Distances on the ellipsoid, `ST_DWithin`, buffers, `ST_Intersection`
questions: How much of each country does each ecoregion cover?
Which records lie within 10 km of a border?

modules.title: Spatial indexes
modules.skill: GiST, the `&&` operator, nearest neighbours with `<->`, reading spatial plans
questions: Which record is nearest to a point, found fast?
When doesn't a spatial index help?

modules.title: Grids
modules.skill: `ST_HexagonGrid` in an equal-area SRID; the modifiable areal unit problem (MAUP)
questions: How many Tasmanian devil records fall in each 5 km hexagon, and in each 10 km one?
How does the picture change with the grid?

modules.title: Rasters
modules.skill: Value at a point; `ST_Clip`, `ST_ValueCount`; estimated areas and their error
questions: Which habitat classes hold Costa Rica's records?
How much of each class does a clip hold, and how good is that estimate?

modules.title: Bias in records
modules.skill: Datasets, basis of record, telemetry, recording effort; framing results honestly
questions: How much of the jaguar sample is GPS-collar data?
Which datasets and years dominate a species' records?
What can records say about where an animal lives, and what can't they?

modules.title: Point patterns
modules.skill: Quadrats, the nearest-neighbour index, kernel density, DBSCAN
questions: Are devil records more clustered than chance?
Where is record density highest?

modules.title: Spatial weights
modules.skill: Distance-band, k-nearest and contiguity weights; row standardization; islands; ties
questions: Who are a cell's neighbours?
What does row standardization do, and what happens to a cell with none?

modules.title: Global Moran's I
modules.skill: Global Moran's I, its expectation, variance and z-score in SQL, matched by PySAL; permutation tests
questions: Does record density cluster across Tasmania?
Do SQL and PySAL agree?
How does the answer change at 10 km?

modules.title: Hot and cold spots
modules.skill: Local Moran's I (LISA) and Getis-Ord Gi*; false discovery rate
questions: Where are the hot and cold spots of recording effort?
Which survive a false discovery rate correction?

modules.title: Zonal statistics
modules.skill: Zonal statistics on polygons and rasters; ratios normalized for effort
questions: Do records over-represent some habitats or ecoregions, once effort is accounted for?

modules.title: Extract
modules.skill: Search API vs download API (asynchronous, with a DOI); paging, rate limits, retries; files with checksums
questions: How do I get every open Tasmanian devil record, with a DOI to cite?

modules.title: Transform and load
modules.skill: Staging tables, types, `COPY`, upserts, geometry; GeoPandas to and from PostGIS
questions: How do I load the download in one transaction, typed and checked, with each record matched to its species?

modules.title: Pipelines you can re-run
modules.skill: Run ids, deterministic outputs, checksums; critwire's own ingest → derive → build as the case study
questions: Can I re-run the pipeline without doubling rows or changing its output?

modules.title: Quality and provenance
modules.skill: Data quality checks written as SQL; license filters; provenance tables; citations; derived datasets
questions: Which datasets must I credit, and under which license?
Which checks stop a bad load?

modules.title: Scheduling
modules.skill: cron, systemd timers, Windows Task Scheduler; logs, alerts, incremental loads
questions: How do I refresh weekly, and know when a run broke?

modules.title: Power Query
modules.skill: Power Query: `Web.Contents` on critwire's CSV files; types with an explicit culture; refresh
questions: How do I load the star from critwire.com so that it refreshes, on any locale?

modules.title: The data model
modules.skill: Relationships, cardinality, filter direction, conformed dimensions, factless facts
questions: How do I filter records and habitat areas by the same country?

modules.title: DAX measures
modules.skill: Measures: `COUNTROWS`, `DISTINCTCOUNT`, `CALCULATE`, ratios
questions: How many records per 1,000 km² of forest, by country?

modules.title: Maps and reports
modules.skill: Map visuals, honest labels, publishing and scheduled refresh
questions: How do I build a report that maps records and never calls them a range?

modules.title: A feed for a game
modules.skill: ETL into PostGIS → Gi* on hexagons → a Power BI report → a static JSON feed a game reads (encounter weights per hexagon, labelled as records)
questions: What could a player meet here, honestly?
